description: Fallback and partial-refresh policy for read-only stock mark refresh before M137 paper market-data preflight.
required_behavior: Run the calendar/session gate before any mark refresh attempt.
Attempt read-only IBKR stock mark refresh when the session gate allows the tick.
When refresh partially misses symbols, optionally reuse rows from a configured existing snapshot only if that fallback snapshot is fresh enough under max_source_age_seconds.
When refresh fails entirely, optionally reuse the configured existing snapshot only if the same fallback freshness and quality thresholds pass.
Preserve fallback row timestamps so the M137 preflight gate can independently block stale reused marks.
Block scheduler execution as skipped_mark_refresh_gate when the required refresh/fallback policy does not allow the tick.
Expose fallback source age, applied symbols, block reasons, and policy status in watch tick, runner, daemon, Markdown, and JSON outputs.
